verdict.rationale: Cekura ships an official MCP server and Skills plugin so AI assistants can "design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations." It also has a CLI for managing agents, scenarios, and runs, sync and async SDKs, a public OpenAPI spec, and a dedicated guide for using it from coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor. Together these cover agent-driven creation of test scenarios, triggering runs, and accessing run data. Missing for 10: an explicit 'dataset' object (scenarios are the closest equivalent), explicit documentation of reading back eval results/scores through the MCP or API, and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent workflow.
